title: Three of the press's lane drains still use v1 paths and break or misfile in v2: collaborators (feedback and enrolments), subscriptions, and telemetry's public report. Fix before the schedules restart, so no lane fills up undrained and no stats are lost
note: Found by the Sherpa on 26 October (press v1.0.34, re-checked on v1.0.40). (1) build/contributors.py line 13: ROOT is two levels above build/ (v1's admin/build/ depth); lines 48 and 58 read and write ROOT/data/contributors.json, so collaborators_drain.py stops with FileNotFoundError before draining. In v2 the file is the data repository's files/contributors.json (kept by the conductor). (2) build/subscriptions_drain.py line 18 reads ../../data/subscriptions.json when it loads: the same failure, before anything is drained. (3) build/telemetry_drain.py drains into the vault and runs, but --site copies the public report to <site>/data/telemetry-report.json; in v2 that file is data's files/telemetry-report.json, so the report reaches no page unless the path changes. The stats themselves are safe in the vault once drained; what is lost is what the lane cannot hold while nobody drains it (board 330 names a 1,000-event cap). conductor_drain.py reads no repository file and works. Proposal: each drain takes its repository file's path from an argument or an environment variable (default: a data clone's files/<name>.json), and writes what belongs to another member's file (an enrolment, a report) as an output for that member to carry into data, not in place. Workaround the Sherpa used for the collaborators lane: a scratch layout <dir>/p/build/ with <dir>/data/contributors.json copied from data; one message drained, no enrolment. No secret is involved: the drains need the vault key the draining session already holds, as before the split; nothing about the lanes, the vaults or the keys changed.
